svg.title: Campus Cards · Set 04 · Irvine · 03/12 San Joaquin Marsh (Rare)
svg.desc: Ponds and cattails right next to campus. Herons stand in the shallows like they are waiting on something. Unofficial. An independent PointCast art project about places. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the University of California or any campus. No university logos, seals, mascots, or marks are used.
